core_obligations: Unramified (proof lines 444-446): by condition (1) and unramified permanence, j is unramified.
Monomorphism (proof lines 447-451): Delta_j is an open immersion (diagonal of unramified morphism), condition (2) makes it bijective on k-points, hence an isomorphism, hence j is a monomorphism.

Equivalence relation (proof lines 451-453 and statement lines 420-438): for every T over S, the maps e, i, c together with the three commutative diagrams of condition (3) exhibit R(T) as a reflexive, symmetric, transitive subset of U(T) x U(T); injectivity on T-points comes from j being a monomorphism.
